Parents who choose Ghazalaat usually hope their child will grow to embody gazelle-like and live with faith, good character and purpose.

For a girl to be named Ghazalaat, she represents an embodiment of the noble pursuits of grace, beauty, and purity – ideals celebrated in both the poetic and military traditions of Islamic culture.

The name Ghazalaat suggests a girl who has started this spiritual journey and is making progress in her quest for spiritual growth and inner peace.
